title: World heads into food crises 'blind' as U.S. aid cuts squeeze UN food agency, experts warn
summary_full: Climate shocks, conflict and a global fuel crisis, on top of surging interest rates and donor cuts, leave agencies less able to help those facing higher food prices.
summary_public: Climate shocks, conflict and a global fuel crisis, on top of surging interest rates and donor cuts, leave agencies less able to help those facing higher food prices.
